Create a research-backed authoring standard and reusable templates for current and future agent-toolkit skills and host roles.

Acceptance criteria:
- Ground format choices in the open Agent Skills specification and current primary host documentation.
- Record empirical evidence, conflicting results, study versions, limitations, and which rules are local decisions.
- Provide compact skill, Codex-role, Copilot-role, and evaluation templates without requiring identical headings or unnecessary resources.
- Inventory all shipped skills and agent definitions, preserving honest gaps in behavioral evidence.
- Add structural validation and meaningful parser/inventory tests to existing development checks.
- Keep runtime behavior, permissions, models, and installation mechanisms unchanged.
- Complete independent review and repository verification; distinguish unavailable environment checks.
- Describe the result as community-aligned until actual external review/endorsement exists.

Requested by Rory in the current authoring-template discussion. This task creates the shared standard and adoption path; it does not claim that every existing agent has already demonstrated improved performance.
